title: Singleton biased monomial identity
statement: Let $0<p<1$, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. With $\mu=1-2p$, $\sigma=\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$, and the biased monomial defined using the associated one-coordinate Fourier basis, the sign at coordinate $i$ satisfies $x_i=\mu+\sigma\,\chi_{\{i\}}(x)$.
